title: Thai Lo Mein Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired stir-fry made with lo mein noodles, vegetables, and a flavorful sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, until translucent.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the minced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lo mein noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and rice vinegar.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and vegetables, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
